search_limit.source: the graph's search op admits a limit of 1..100 passages (graph/src/store/search.av)

choice_letters.source: the shared service's choose op letters 2..26 options (graph/extract/cascade.py)

answer_tokens.source: the shared service's generate op caps an answer at 4096 tokens when none is asked (graph/extract/cascade.py)

draft_tries.source: one draft per question: a retry is a measured choice (--tries), not a default

question_years.source: years either side of the asking year offered for a question's time; a starting point to fit against labelled questions, not fitted
